Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume XI,
                    South Asia Crisis, 1971
299. Backchannel Message From the Ambassador to Pakistan (
Farland
) to the Presidentʼs
                        Assistant for National Security Affairs (
Kissinger
)
1
Islamabad
,
December 14, 1971,
                            1055Z
.
1092. When I returned home from seeing
Yahya
this noon, he telephoned to say that while his
                        instructions to
Bhutto
remained
                        valid, in the event India insisted on pursuing the war. “I will have to have
                        twenty B–57s immediately.” I told him I would pass this message along,
                        without assurances. Warm regards.
